item.title: Ask HN: Is Traditional SaaS Dying?
item.summary: I think a good proxy for the question is: Does your employer try to replicate some SaaS features in-house? And do these experiments mostly succeed? My data points: Two internal projects to replace Hubspot and Float. Hubspot will be kept, Float will be replaced. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49242046 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
